fnol_text: My name is Viktor Kaminski and I live at 980 Willow Lane, Clinton, NC 28338. You can reach me on (555) 699-7070 or viktor.kaminski@example.com. I was stopped at lights on 5 May 2026 when the car behind, driven by Kofi Santos, went into the back of mine. Rear bumper and boot are badly damaged. Policy MT-2023-00076. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Kaminski on (555) 699-7070 to acknowledge the claim. Viktor confirmed the loss date as 5 May 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Bianca Fitzgerald gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Kofi Santos reports lacerations to the forearm and attended County General. Viktor reports whiplash.
